I thought I could just sit back and act as a figurehead.
I was wrong.
[Constellation ‘Wisdom Contained in a Single Eye’ has sent a request.] 
| Godslayer (Guild Master) |: For the love of—can we please take on some requests, people?!
| 9th Circle Archmage |: (૭ ᐕ)૭?
| Godslayer (Guild Master) |: Oh, for the—ugh.
Too many people were dying right before my eyes for me to ignore it.
But the difficulty of these requests kept climbing beyond what I could handle alone.
So I decided…
| Godslayer (Guild Master) |: Behold! The epitome of a true cold city man!
| Godslayer (Guild Master) |: Who wants to hear the Northern Grand Duke’s sultry flirting?
| Northern Grand Duke |: W-Wait! Hold on—STOP!!
I figured I’d push the guild members into action using… slightly underhanded tactics.
But then—
“Guild Master, you’ve been playing us all this time, haven’t you?”
“So, where do you think you’re going?”
I had no idea I’d end up digging my own grave.

102993.synopsis:
After returning from a trip, Xiang Er discovered strange things constantly happening around her.
On the damp walls of her rented apartment, mushrooms of bizarre colors and strange shapes sprouted;
Opening the refrigerator, an icy tentacle suddenly sprung out, clinging intimately to her cheek;
In the dark of night, a sticky, soft black shadow dripped mucus, plop plop, advancing across the ceiling, slowly entwining itself around her body…
Her dreams were gloomy and damp, mountains and rivers spinning, heaven and earth inverted.
Xiang Er awoke, covered in sweat, realizing…
She had been targeted by a “Cthulhu”(Evil God).
*
Xiang Er met a mysterious and beautiful woman.
She wore a red dress, her beauty breathtaking, making Xiang Er experience a feeling of infatuation she had never known before.
The woman took the initiative to move in with Xiang Er, helping her deal with troublesome matters, and in times of danger, risking herself so that Xiang Er could escape first.
Xiang Er finally fell deeply, deciding to tell her all her secrets, including the “Cthulhu”.
The woman in the red dress blinked slowly, curving her bright red lips and asking:
“So, do you like it?”
Xiang Er thought she was asking if she liked her, so she blushed, her eyes misty as she nodded.
The woman laughed, the corners of her mouth slowly widening, thick, dark red tent**les rising high behind her, swaying slowly and joyfully.
“I… like you too.”
*
The unnameable Cthulhu, casting its gaze from the endless crevices of time and space, saw Xiang Er’s pale face and dark, bewildered eyes.
From then on, Xiang Er was destined to become the Cthulhu’s plaything.
Unable to escape, eternally lost.
Content Tags: Thriller, Urban, Love at First Sight, Daily Life, Evil God(Cthulhu)

103761.synopsis:
“Back then, I was out of my mind. I’m sorry. You don’t like me anyway, so why don’t we just get a divorce?” Yuan Lingling looked sincerely at the unbelievably handsome man in front of her.
After transmigrating into the novel as the missing ex-wife of the main villain, Yuan Lingling only had one goal—to stay far away from him and avoid disappearing again. She had no interest in winning over the villain; she just wanted to leave as soon as possible.
Who would have thought that he was completely unfazed?
“Divorce? What do you take me for!”
Little did Yuan Lingling know, the villain assumed she wanted a divorce so she could run off with some s*umbag.
Who could have guessed? She only wanted to be a cool single mom, but the villain had already painted an entire field of green over his own head.
—
Shen Caisheng’s thoughts were simple. If he couldn’t have it easy, then no one else would either.
She was the one who drugged him and climbed into his bed, and now she was also the one asking for a divorce. How could things go so smoothly for her?
—
Since she couldn’t get a divorce, Yuan Lingling came up with another plan—to run away.
With her severe claustrophobia, there was absolutely no way she could ever be with the villain who had imprisoned the original owner of this body for twenty years.
The first time she ran away, she got so emotional that she fainted and was taken to the hospital. That was when the baby in her belly was exposed, and the villain watched her even more closely. She decided to find an ally.
The second time she ran away, the ally she finally managed to recruit became best friends with the villain and even tried to persuade her to stay. Fortunately, she remained firm in her decision.
Before she could attempt a third escape, the villain placed his military officer’s badge, various honorary medals, and a marriage application in front of her.
“We already have a child together but still haven’t gotten our marriage certificate. That’s against the rules.”
Yuan Lingling didn’t even hear what he was saying. Her gaze swept over the items, and her heart filled with dread.
This man was getting crazier by the day. He would even go as far as to forge official documents.
Heaven help her. Someone, please save her!
—
1. A slice-of-life story with everyday family drama.
2. A fictional setting inspired by the 1980s, with no historical accuracy.
3. The male lead acts roguish because he is working undercover. He has a clear stance on right and wrong and is not actually a villain. The heroine’s disappearance was not caused by him, but rather a misunderstanding on her part.
associated_names: Becoming the Villain’s Ex-Wife but Unable to Divorce [Era]
成为反派前妻离不了婚[年代]

105297.synopsis:
After her rebirth, the first thing she did was retrieve the marriage report, find ‘Third Sister’ to get the IOU, and then head to the Lu family to annul the engagement with the s*umbag.
In her previous life, she had married the s*umbag, but lived a life like a maid sold into servitude to his family. 
A sickly father, a blind mother, and a perpetually ill daughter—all the burdens of life had fallen squarely on her shoulders. He didn’t care for his wife or daughter, nor for his own parents, devoting his life to working like a beast of burden for another woman and her child. Under the pretense of looking after a friend’s widow, he protected her for a lifetime, but left all the hardships to his wife.
Later, the daughter she had raised with such difficulty also betrayed her and married ‘Third Sister’s’ worthless son. The betrayal sent her to the hospital, where her own daughter cruelly pulled the plug on her oxygen tank, sighing in relief, “Finally, my mother is dead. Dad, now you and your true love can finally be together.”
It was then she realized that she had never had a real family. The four of them, father, daughter, and ‘Third Sister,’ were happy together, and she was the extra one, an outsider.
In this new life, she no longer meddled in his affairs. She broke off the engagement and married the cold-faced military officer next door, and her days steadily improved. 
He, out of gratitude, finally married the widow he had always cared for. ‘Third Sister’s’ dream came true, and she was now living the “good life” she had always wanted in her previous life… but why was she crying every day?
associated_names: 重生后，我果断退婚转嫁冷面军少

106577.synopsis:
At a young age, I was caught up in a Gate incident and barely made it out alive. 
They called me a “miracle child,” Jung Jehee.  
But that so-called “miracle” meant nothing—I had only barely survived. 
I lost my sight, my ability to move freely, and was even diagnosed as terminally ill. 
Trapped in a hospital room, all I could do was wait for the day I would die…  
Then, in a moment of life-or-death crisis, I awakened as Korea’s first-ever S-rank.  
After a long, long hospital stay, my new life as an S-rank began. 
It should have been something to celebrate.  
So why is it that my childhood friend, Im Taehwan, who had been so devoted to me throughout my years of illness, is acting so strange?  
“Jehee… don’t tell me… you can see through me?”  
Even after learning about my awakening, he seemed oddly unsettled.  
“After you’re discharged, I was thinking… how about living with me?”  
He insisted on living together for some reason.  
“Once you’re out, why don’t we go study abroad? Anywhere is fine.”  
Out of nowhere, he started suggesting we move overseas together.  
For thirteen years, he took care of me every single day. He should be free to live his own life now.  
For the sake of my kind but stubborn friend, I tried my best to gain independence from him.  
But then—  
“Ah, that? It’s called a re-awakening.”
“Seems like I got a little stronger.”  
To make matters worse, my childhood friend followed right behind me—awakening as the second-ever S-rank in Korea.  
Just days after I became the first.  
“How did Taehwan end up awakening as an S-rank like me…?”  
Is S-rank something contagious?  
This is getting seriously weird.  
* * * 
“Jung Jehee. Do you really not want to live with me?”  
“You’re in danger just by being with me. You’re only a B-rank and don’t even have combat abilities. At best, you’re just a normal person with slightly better stamina and strength.”  
Could Taehwan, who has a non-combat ability, really protect me?  
He stayed silent, as if he couldn’t argue with what I said.  
“No, it’s just that…”  
“You only said your house feels empty to reassure my mom, didn’t you? The truth is, you like being alone—that’s why you never joined a guild. I know how hard it is for solo artifact creators to survive. And yet, you insist on staying independent.”  
“No, it’s true that I like being alone. But… you…”  
“I’m a bit special?”  
“…Uh… well… no, I mean…”  
“So? What exactly do you mean?”  
“…You are… a little special… I guess…?”  
Avoiding my gaze, he mumbled under his breath, “We’re friends, after all…”  
For someone so big, he still acts just like he did when we were kids.  
He won’t meet my eyes, yet he won’t let go of me either.

108881.synopsis:
I, Nabana Kurumi, and my classmate, Sorahashi Sera, weren’t even friends yet, and we rarely spoke to each other in class. Compared to her, someone that was often said to be the cutest girl in the entire school, my unremarkable self was in a completely different position on the social ladder.
In spite of all that, I was…
Right now, I was about to put a collar on her.
「……Alright. I’m putting it on now.」
I gently touched her hair, brushing her golden locks aside so they sat on her shoulder.
Then, I set the light pink collar around her pale neck.
associated_names: Kurasu no Hime wa Watashi no Wanko
クラスの姫は私のわんこ

112465.synopsis:
As soon as my girlfriend awakened as an S-class, she abandoned me.
But upon learning the truth, it turned out she awakened as an S-class thanks to me.
Neither I nor she knew that fact at the time we broke up…
And after a little time passed, I learned that I could also cancel her S-class awakening again.

114769.synopsis:
“Divorce me, my love.”
The day she was suddenly served divorce papers and saw her friend, heavily pregnant with her husband’s child.
Sylaria died.
She had devoted herself to him, helped him become the crown prince, and yet, in the end, all she received in return was betrayal.
Having returned to the past and come back to life, Sylaria plotted her revenge.
Her target: her husband’s half-brother, the cold and ascetic first imperial prince, Euclid.
“Even if it’s just a sham engagement, that’s fine. As long as I can break off my own engagement with Arendtert…”
However.
Euclid, who was supposed to be obsessed with hunting monsters… began to change.
*
“Marry you? That’s exactly what I wanted to say.”
He accepts Sylaria’s proposal as if he’d been waiting for it, and immediately secures the emperor’s permission for marriage.
“This is the first time in my life I’ve ever felt this way.”
He comes to her at all hours, asking her to purify his mana.
“Sylaria. You have no idea what it means to me to have met you.”
In her previous life, he had been a man who remained indifferent to women for his entire life.
“You are my only Purifier. The Purifier I have waited for all my life.”
Was this really the Euclid she once knew?
associated_names: Dear Cheating Husband, My Answer is a Transfer of Marriage

116049.synopsis:
Mu Zi’an’s soul transmigrated into the son of the State-Stabilizing Duke of Great Li. His predecessor had been willing to humble himself and offer everything for love, yet all he received in return was a heartless rejection.
Lu Yunxue said, “Accepting your gifts doesn’t mean I agree to be with you.”
In a fit of anger, he triggered the Choice System.
Choice 1: Endure humiliation, silently sacrificing for love. Reward: A generational green hat.
Choice 2: Fight back directly, cutting ties once and for all. Reward: The Strength of a Fierce Tiger, a single punch carrying ten thousand jin.
Mu Zi’an decisively tore up the marriage contract in the street.
[Ding! Congratulations to the host for making a choice! Reward obtained: The Strength of a Fierce Tiger, a punch of ten thousand jin.] 
[Ding! Congratulations to the host for making a choice! Summoning the number one poisonous strategist of the Three Kingdoms, Jia Xu.] 
[Ding! Congratulations to the host for making a choice!]
associated_names: 開局撕婚書，我成就最強鎮國公！

118353.synopsis:
The lecherous Demon Lord Kima, who was once obsessed with women, dies by the Hero’s sword and is reborn as a succubus.
Casting aside her pride as a Demon Lord, she commits herself to the oblivious Hero, scheming to infiltrate the enemy’s ranks and steal away all of his female companions for herself.
“I’ll make that bastard regret it so much he’ll be rolling at my feet, begging for mercy!”
“Gima?”
“Ah, the food’s almost ready! Come have a taste~you first.”
“It’s delicious! Meeting you is one of the luckiest things that’s ever happened to me, Gima.”
Just you wait, kid. You’ll be crying your eyes out soon enough! You just wait.
associated_names: Even if the Demon King switches genders, he’s still out for revenge, duh.
魔王大人即使变身也要复仇哟

120401.synopsis:
I was supposed to be a hero who would save the world with invincible power.
But before that setting could take place, due to an accident……
“I never thought you’d be so eager to be bullied that you’d choose such a body?”
“That’s not it! This is all a misunderstanding!!!”
Being treated as a maid by a black-haired girl, I thus embarked on my journey.
associated_names: 重生后我被公主变成奴婢女仆

124497.synopsis:
1.
Pei Jiyin encountered a Green Tea Girl while gaming.  
The girl’s voice was sweet and coquettish, melting into one’s bones with her acting cute.  
Unfortunately, the tea wasn’t directed at her—but at the Jungler Gaming Partner she had hired.  
“Big brother, can you give me the blue buff?”  
“Big brother, I want a kill too…”  
…  
After Pei Jiyin took three consecutive blue buffs from the Jungler, the girl finally couldn’t hold back.  
“Big sister, how could you do this?”  
“Little sister, I paid for him. So, that’s my blue. I’m not giving it up. Thanks.”  
2.  
Song Zhen deeply regretted two things:  
First, that she had lost her mind and decided to stir up trouble by acting like a Green Tea Girl.  
Second, that she had actually accepted that woman’s invitation and boarded the Death Spirit Car.  
What kind of Yao Yao Princess had a win rate of only twenty percent?  
That woman was the most terrifying Jungler she had ever seen—no contest.  
Later, she realized the woman’s Jungler skills were actually god-tier—she had just been deliberately trolling her.
associated_names: She's Been Exposed As a Fake Green Tea B*tch

128081.synopsis:
The streamer I liked just posted some cosplay photos.
I went wild in the comments:
“You look so familiar, just like my husband.
“Your cosplay is still missing something. Because you only cosplay, but you never play with me.”
The streamer raised his eyebrows, took off his mask, and his voice sounded so familiar:
“Take another look, will you?”
Crap.
It really was my husband.
That night, my husband-who I’d been separated from for years-pinned me to the bed, a half-smile on his face:
“Wife, what kind of play do you like? Want to try it tonight?”

128593.synopsis:
Swords and Legions is a strategy simulation RPG, a kind of war chronicle game. I was so addicted to it that for the past few years, it’s pretty much all I’ve played. And so today, as I started my daily routine of playing Legions, about to begin what must be my zillionth playthrough… the next moment, I was sitting on a throne, clad in armor. WHY?!
Panicked, I realized the place I was in was the very castle that served as the base in Legions. Did I come to the world of the game? No, no, that’s impossible! As I screamed in the throne room, a person burst in… and that person was one of the subordinate characters I had edited and created in the game…
This is the story of a fool who, armed with overpowered abilities gained from endless playthroughs and the maxed-out loyalty of his custom characters, gets carried away and tries to play the role of an overlord!
associated_names: Haou ni Natte kara Isekai ni Kiteshimatta! Edit shita Game Chara-tachi to Isekai wo Juurin suru Wagahaou
I Became the Overlord in Another World!
覇王になってから異世界に来てしまった！　～エディットしたゲームキャラ達と異世界を蹂躙する我覇王～

132945.synopsis:
I reincarnated into the world of a novel.
And not just any novel, but my favorite one, Square Illusion.
In this life, I was the daughter of a powerful duke, born with a golden spoon in my mouth.
The darling of my family, showered with love. That was me.
The problem? I was Sylvia Langston, fiancée to the crown prince, and the villainess of the story.
My fate was a brutal death.
Executed the moment I turn twenty, as a punishment for all the sins Sylvia had committed.
But how could I accept that? How could I give up this healthy body I’d been granted, the family I’d finally found?
Absolutely not!
“Then… just live a good life.”
That advice came from Ray, a background character never even mentioned in the book, and my nanny’s nephew.
From that moment, Sylvia’s fate veered off its rails.
“Ray, I don’t want to be Crown Princess. His Highness just isn’t my type.”
“Then who is your type? Black hair and red eyes, as you once mentioned? The title of that book was… Square Illusion, wasn’t it?”
“Y-you remember that? But I said it when we were really young!”
“I remember everything you like.”
Without realizing it, I spilled the secrets of the original story to Ray.
As for being the crown princess? The heroine could keep that role.
Once she appeared and tied up the original plot, I planned to set off with Ray, traveling the world, tasting and savoring life firsthand.
╭══ ≪ •❈• ≫ ══╮
“Are you insane? Do you even know where you’ve come?”
Three years later, I met my childhood friend again. But Ray was no longer ordinary.
“I’ll come back for you. Wait for me.”
The promise he’d made to me seemed thrown away like garbage. By his side now stood none other than the novel’s heroine herself.
Betrayal burned in my chest, tears stinging my eyes—but I held them back.
“Do you know who I am? Your insolence has no limits. To think you’d dare speak so rudely to the esteemed daughter of Duke Langston!”
associated_names: I Didn’t Know He Was the Villain and Told the Original Story
흑막인 줄 모르고 원작을 말해 버렸다

137553.synopsis:
The moment I discovered I was the fake daughter of the Duke’s family,
I decided to be nice to Matthias, the Duke’s illegitimate son who would kill me in the future.
After all, he might at least spare my life then!
But, this villain I thought was cruel and ruthless is kinder than expected?
“Don’t worry. With my abilities, I can easily provide for you.”
He comforts me when I’m bullied for helping him.
“Rael, from now on, I’ll protect you so that you won’t be hurt by anyone or have to bow your head to anyone.”
He even swears to protect me with such tender words.
The villain’s affection might be quite sweet after all?
* * *
“If you want to leave my side, you’ll have to kill me right here.”
Rael’s hands trembled at his words.
She was afraid of Matthias’s obsession.
She knew that if his obsession ever changed, he might hold a knife to her throat,
and that this relationship would eventually drive them both to ruin.

140113.synopsis:
[Invincible Protagonist] + [Abyss Invasion] + [Game-Leveling Mechanics] + [Growth-Type Talent] + [Territory Boss] + [World of Warcraft Elements] 
The Abyss has locked onto Blue Star, waiting for the right moment to invade.
In response, the Will of the Universe launches a global MMORPG called “Redemption”, granting humanity the chance to evolve and fight back.
Yang Jian, who has transmigrated into this world, enters the game with a cheat and awakens a growth-type talent.
From dominating the game world to commanding the battlefield—
His journey to becoming the First-Generation Legendary Boss begins now.
associated_names: 游戏入侵，我要当初代目大佬

141905.synopsis:
After the celestial phenomenon of the Nine Stars Align, all the gods in the world mysteriously vanished overnight! 
Dormant demons began to wreak havoc, with plagues raging, severe droughts ravaging, and floods inundating the land, leaving the common people in misery. In this chaotic world, Lu Jueming transmigrated into a Cat Demon and obtained the “Deity Role-Playing System”. 
As long as he role-played as a deity to provide protection for the villagers, he could gain their faith and incense, unlock “Deity Authority,” and enhance his own strength. 
Hiding behind the deity statue, the little “ha jimi” began to strategize and role-play as a deity, protecting the common people, using the power of faith from the people to fight against natural disasters, slay demons and monsters, and break evil spirits!
[You have successfully fulfilled the wish of a villager, Believer +1, unlocked the Mountain God Authority Divine Ability “Plants and Trees as Soldiers!”] 
[You have successfully resolved the plague and saved the entire village’s Villagers, Believer +1000, unlocked the Divine Ability “Divine Might Beast Taming Art!”] 
[You have slain the Disaster Beast Hanba, resolved the severe drought, Believer +10000, unlocked the Divine Ability “Heavenly Star Burst!”] 
[……] 
Just as Lu Jueming was creating one Divine Miracle after another, the ruling Imperial Court learned of rumors of a deity reviving in the remote mountains. Suspecting that demons were bewitching the villagers, they ordered the General of the Demon-Suppressing Bureau to lead numerous Demon Hunters to investigate…
associated_names: 开局成狸猫？我靠扮演神明成仙！

184401.synopsis:
My daughter’s love is too heavy, placing me in danger of condemnation!?
Mark Stuart realized he had reincarnated as a mid-boss in a game.
In the game, the fate of being condemned by his daughter, Folcina, who is known as the “Ice Young Lady,” awaited him.
Reflecting on his past of treating her coldly, he decides to earn Affection points to change the future.
Through gentle consideration and his active role as a Duke, his daughter regains her love and trust for her father—but he overdid it, and her love gradually becomes too heavy!?
Furthermore, a conspiracy that doesn’t exist in the game scenario closes in on the father and daughter.
The Villainous Duke will stand against the world’s ruin while earning his daughter’s Affection points!
associated_names: Musume ni Danzai sareru Akuyaku Koushaku ni Tensei shitemashita: Akuyaku Muubu wo Yameta no ni Naze ka Musume ga “Koori no Reijou” ka suru Ken
娘に断罪される悪役公爵に転生してました 悪役ムーブをやめたのになぜか娘が『氷の令嬢』化する件
